shared_elements: tall upright slab carved in low relief
figures arranged in stacked registers/zones on the vertical face
row of repeated smaller motifs along an upper band
relief carved against a flat cleared background
justification: Both are tall vertical faces bearing low-relief imagery organised into stacked horizontal zones, with a band of repeated small motifs across the upper part and a larger figure below, which is the most specific correspondence. But the content differs fundamentally: A is dominated by schematic animals in profile (birds with hooked beaks, a snake, quadrupeds) with a tiny subsidiary human-like figure, while B is a single frontal, densely ornamented human figure with elaborate headdress and held attributes filling the whole panel, rendered in a far more crowded, naturalistically proportioned manner.
